definition: A trie is a tree of strings in which each edge is a character and each path from the root spells a key. Lookup depends on the length of the key, not on how many keys are stored. Shared prefixes share nodes, which also makes prefix queries natural.

complexity.time: Lookup, insert, and delete are O(k), where k is the length of the key.
complexity.space: O(total characters stored), with sharing of common prefixes.

examples: A routing table matched by the longest prefix
